title: Raku Firing Workshops
source_quote: Studio 360° will features 2- hour lessons, kids classes, Raku firing workshops, primitive firing workshops, and multi-week classes.
evidence_sentence: The 360° Community Studio offers raku firing workshops as part of its multi-week and multi-session class offerings.
summary: Eckels Pottery's 360° Community Studio offers raku firing workshops. No specific dates or registration information are provided on this page.
how_to_join: Contact Eckels Pottery or visit the classes page for details.
